SV-07.limitations: 16.5 checks executed on the X1 run roots of 257267c (python -m cam_live.eval.meta_checks). Finding: at the live bootstrap mix 1.0 the learned reward has NO effect on the inner policy update (delta theta psi_post vs psi_pre = 0.0 in every root); it acts only at mix 0 (seed 0: 0.021 against an update norm of 0.028); 4 of 110 meta-update records applied in X1 (8 of 233 over X0 + X1), the rest skipped (insufficient independent outcomes, zero advantage)

SV-08.limitations: attack battery + trivial world executed on 257267c (CPU, debug configuration, engineering diagnostic): the battery's trigger occurred in 1 of 5 seeds (every delivered attack refused, verdict unchanged), 4 seeds tested nothing; no integrity experiment on the substantive families

SV-09.limitations: N_q (decisions to verified achievement, censored at 20) measured: X0 per-seed means 13.7 / 10.3 / 14.0, X1 10.75 / 7.75 / 6.25; S_q not measured (X2 did not run: no initial / experienced pair); AULC not computed for the substantive runs

SV-10.limitations: X2 not run on 257267c (re-scope): only initial_s0 2 of 3 held-out objectives ran (SW:unique achieved in 6, SW:base in 9); no experienced arm, no S_q

SV-11.limitations: every reported result comes from an executed run whose code identity is recorded (snapshot commit per run, eval code per objective, checked by v3_report --expect-commit); experiments that did not run are reported as not run; pre-fix results are reported separately and never pooled

SV-12.limitations: scaling infrastructure exists (python -m cam_live.eval.cli scaling / large); no scaling run on 257267c

SV-13.limitations: X3 (baselines A-D on the same architecture and action generation) did not run on the baseline snapshot 257267c: coordinator re-scope (257267c is the pre-amendment baseline; the comparison runs on the amended snapshot). Only debug-scale diagnostics exist (docs/evidence/S/diagnostics/v2_*).

SV-14.limitations: action-quality measures recorded per objective on 257267c (executable fraction of chosen actions X0 0.91 / X1 0.96, backbone-written fraction, repeats of failed actions, distinct strategies); no controlled comparison of highly evaluated actions against alternatives on the substantive families (the shadow evaluation needs per-candidate ground truth, which SW / MECH lack)

SV-15.limitations: X1 on 257267c: pre / post exports, weight-group changes per objective (adapters changed in 10 of 12 objectives), slow-step guard outcomes (25 kept / 8 reverted / 1 deferred of 34), prediction NLL, action quality and verified competence per objective; the sequence confounds position with problem and the runs are not reproducible from the seed, so no learning effect on competence is established

CL-07.limitations: the fresh-process weights-only child ran on the real configuration (empty working directory and CAM_LIVE_HOME, store / registries / fast state empty, 500 tensors loaded strictly, group hashes match the export); the experienced arm and the comparison did not run on 257267c (re-scope)

AE-07.limitations: meta_checks.shadow_checkpoints ran on the X1 roots but evaluates nothing on SW (n = 0: no per-candidate ground truth); shadow comparison exists only in the debug-scale diagnostics (v2_*_shadow.json)

CU-33.limitations: X4 (skills vs primitive, learner in the loop) did not run on 257267c (re-scope); the only runs are on the superseded snapshot 48600c4

OP-10.limitations: pre-amendment baseline on the full-size agent (Qwen3-4B + 50m core + adapters, open-ended generation on, 512 tokens) on the open-ended families SW and MECH with independent signing verifiers: X0 5 / 9 achieved, X1 11 / 12, X5 5 / 8 assigned objectives; MECH never achieved (0 / 3); X2-X4 not run on this snapshot; 2-3 seeds, no significance claims (Protocol v3.5)
